name: Source Natural Foods and Herbal Supplements Limited
about: Source Natural Foods and Herbal Supplements Limited manufactures and sells ayurveda, health and dietary supplements, and food products in India. The company offers beverages, supplements, arkas, single herbs, and churnas products. It provides healthcare products for ortho, diabetic, digestive, respiratory, skin, heart, liver, kidney care, pain relief, weight loss, mental wellness, immune-modulator and anti-oxidants, natural vitamins and supplements, opthal and ENT care, women's wellness, and hair and scalp health. In addition, the company offers food products, including health drinks, herbal teas, chayawanprash, health powders, masalas and spices, staples and grains, and flours. Further, it engages in renewable energy generation. The company was formerly known as Inwinex Pharmaceuticals Limited and changed its name to Source Natural Foods and Herbal Supplements Limited in June 2012. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Bengaluru, India. Source Natural Foods and Herbal Supplements Limited is a subsidiary of Sriveda Sattva Private Limited.
